data_objects.name: daily_asset_market_bars
data_objects.meaning: Daily open-high-low-close market data with trading volume and market capitalization for one unidentified asset.
data_objects.notes: Volume and market capitalization use comma-grouped numeric text, and rows are ordered from later to earlier dates.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the daily market bar.

variables.name: Volume
variables.meaning: Trading volume for the date, encoded with comma thousands separators.

variables.name: Market Cap
variables.meaning: Market capitalization for the date, encoded with comma thousands separators.

structure.description: Each row is a daily OHLC bar with volume and market capitalization; Date serves as the temporal identifier.
Rows are in reverse chronological order, while Volume and Market Cap are numeric quantities stored as comma-formatted text.

uncertainties: The asset, venue, market calendar, and time-zone convention are not identified.
The price and market-capitalization currency and the basis of trading volume are not stated.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv table was used as evidence.
